about: Popups close on a click outside, and on Escape (2026-11-22: a click anywhere outside a window closes it). Run on the made-up floor, live.html?stress=6. The outside click does only that: a column clicked while Plan use is open is not focused. A click inside a panel (its text field if it has one, else its body) keeps it; a drag from inside to outside keeps it; another top-right button switches straight to its panel.

actions.log: Plan use, then a click on a column of the floor: the panel closes and nothing is selected
Providers, then a click inside it: it stays

actions.note: its sign-in code field, when a provider is waiting for one

actions.log: a drag that starts inside the panel and ends on the floor: it stays
Plan use open, then the Providers button: Providers open, Plan use closed, in one click
